newsitem.title: JAPAN: TOCOM to raise rubber futures margin fees.
newsitem.headline: TOCOM to raise rubber futures margin fees.

text.p: The Tokyo Commodity Exchange (TOCOM) said on Wednesday it would raise the margin requirements on its September and October rubber futures contracts, effective from Thursday.
It will raise its margin requirement on the September contract by 20,000 yen per trading lot, bringing the total September requirement to 147,750 yen, TOCOM said.

The margin for the October contract will increase by 10,000 yen per lot to 62,500 yen. The increases are intended to cool overheated trade. The requirement on other rubber contracts will be unchanged at 52,500 yen, it said.
